data.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?

result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For a small team, my top recommendation is **1Password**\.

It offers the best overall balance of security, ease of use, shared credentials, and administrative controls without making password management feel like an IT project.

The important thing is to choose a manager designed for teams, rather than simply sharing a family or individual password-manager account.

## Best options compared

![1Password 8.12 - TidBITS](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/34HDvvYhqgd6AnMFmrlTm3hAXFxcbeGEwY_LB_XZ_XGVtrk4a2QxTEX-2LBZt2GGXhIIaKEolAWfkyjqt2bzeCs60tKyMvcGjArpm-vdyy1ZPxujq2f9_l2uItYJrXcwCcU9bPBSy8AGv_Ou2YF6Ce5xYeilxXBZ8f7ED4T1F4V2OwIPdBn46M8zBrxXTO4w?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

- Excellent user experience
- Shared vaults with granular permissions
- Easy employee onboarding and offboarding
- Strong admin and security controls

Best for teams that want something polished and easy to adopt.

Teams Starter Pack: approximately C\$29.95/month for up to 10 people, annually billed. [www.northvetted.ca](https://www.northvetted.ca/reviews/best-password-manager-canada?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

- Open-source
- Shared collections and team management
- Good security and audit features
- More affordable than 1Password

Best if keeping costs low is important.

Teams: approximately US\$4/user/month, annually billed. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

- Strong administrative controls
- Shared folders
- Detailed access management
- Good for compliance-focused businesses

Best if you have more demanding security requirements.

Business Starter pricing starts around US\$2/user/month, annually billed. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[geekchamp.com](https://geekchamp.com/best-password-managers-for-small-business-teams-with-shared-access-controls/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

- Privacy-focused
- End-to-end encryption
- Shared vaults
- Useful if you already use Proton services

Best for privacy-conscious teams.

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

## What I'd prioritize

Whichever product you choose, make sure it supports\:

1. Shared team vaults with individual permissions.
2. Mandatory MFA for all employees.
3. Immediate access revocation when someone leaves.
4. Audit logs showing who accessed or changed credentials.
5. Separate personal and company passwords.
6. Secure sharing of API keys, Wi-Fi credentials and service accounts.

## My recommendation

I'd narrow it down to **1Password vs. Bitwarden**\.

- Choose 1Password if ease of use, employee adoption and a polished experience matter most.
- Choose Bitwarden if you want strong team functionality at a lower price.

One question that would help me make a more definitive recommendation\:

**How many people are on your team?**
